ideal_requirements.text: See the corresponding moment immediately while exploring the timeline, without interrupting current viewing.
Attach brief personal labels to any moment and discover those notes in context whenever the timeline appears.
Remembered moments are already present whenever the same video is revisited, without separate saving or organization.
Return effortlessly to a remembered moment, and correct or remove its note when desired.
Original videos stay intact, and videos and personal notes remain private by default.
Exploring and remembering moments preserves comfortable, accessible playback and control.
The experience is dependable, and what the product can actually do is clear and trustworthy.
